prompt.content: Who was the commander of the High Seas Fleet during the bombardment of Scarborough, Hartlepool, and Whitby?

output:
The commander of the High Seas Fleet during the **bombardment of Scarborough, Hartlepool, and Whitby** (19 November 1914) was **Admiral Reinhard Scheer**. He was the commander-in-chief of the High Seas Fleet at that time.
